biggest_catch: This is a business card: you need a real business activity to apply, even a sole proprietorship or freelance work, and you sign a personal guarantee, so the debt is yours. Year-one math: $750 cash back minus the $0 annual fee leaves $750 net in the first year. Only claim this if your business was already going to spend $6,000 in 3 months on normal purchases; never spend extra to hit the target. Chase states the new-cardmember bonus may not be available if you have ever had this card, and its unpublished 5/24 pattern also applies to business-card applicants.
catches: Only claim this if your business was already going to spend the money anyway; never spend extra just to hit the $6,000 minimum, because manufactured spending turns a bonus into debt.

Year-one math: $750 cash back minus the $0 annual fee leaves $750 net in the first year. From year two there is no fee and no bonus, so the card only keeps paying you through its normal 1.5% unlimited cash back on business purchases.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry on your personal credit report, and you sign a personal guarantee, so the business-card balance is legally your personal debt if the business does not pay.
This card's APR is around 20% or higher, so carrying a balance would wipe out the bonus fast. Pay the statement balance in full every month or this offer loses you money.
Chase's unpublished 5/24 pattern: five or more new personal cards opened in the last 24 months generally means denial, even for business-card applicants with excellent credit.
Chase states the new-cardmember bonus may not be available to you if you have ever had this card. Do not open a second Ink Business Unlimited expecting the bonus again.
You need a genuine business activity to apply, including an eligible sole proprietorship or freelance operation. A personal guarantee means the issuer can pursue you personally for the balance.
The account must be open and not in default when the bonus is paid, and the bonus is paid only once per account.

steps: Go to the official Chase Ink Business Unlimited page and read the current offer headline and the Pricing & Terms before anything else.
Confirm you have genuine business activity (a sole proprietorship or freelance work counts) and understand you will sign a personal guarantee.
Apply online as the business, using your personal details as guarantor. Expect a hard inquiry on your personal credit report.
Use the card for the business purchases you were already planning, totaling at least $6,000 in the first 3 months from account opening.
Pay the statement balance in full every month; do not carry a balance at the ~20%+ APR.
Allow 6-8 weeks after the spending requirement is met for the $750 cash back to post, and confirm it appears as Ultimate Rewards cash back.
Keep using the card for its 1.5% unlimited cash back on business spending if that fits; there is no fee either way.
timing: Spend $6,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. Bonus posts after qualifying purchases, typically 6-8 weeks after the spending requirement is met.
